visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair wearing a white high-collar shirt stands in front of a red pleated curtain background. He holds a peach-colored box, opens it to reveal a nine-shade eyeshadow palette with various neutral and brown tones. He smiles warmly with squinted eyes, gesturing with his hands to present the product's elegant packaging and color variety to the camera. (2) Quick transitions show commercial posters of a male and female model with bold earth-toned eye makeup in a studio setting. Large bold text "ASSAM" and "KAIBEAUTY" is prominent on the glossy posters. The lighting in these images is high-contrast cinematic, emphasizing skin texture and the vibrant pigmented shades of the eyeshadow being advertised. (3) The scene shifts to a long, oval white table in a stylish indoor restaurant with warm ambient lighting. Each place setting is meticulously arranged with a palette, professional makeup brushes, and a circular desktop mirror, creating a luxurious themed atmosphere. A large television screen in the background displays promotional slides for the brand's new product launch. (4) Extreme close-up shots highlight raw ingredients like cinnamon sticks, red peppercorns, and loose grains arranged in rustic ceramic bowls, visually connecting the makeup shades to natural spices. The man shows an intricate black henna-style tattoo on his index finger and touches his cheek, demonstrating the smooth texture of the cosmetic product on his skin. (5) The man poses alongside a curly-haired male model, both holding the eyeshadow palette near their faces for the camera. A quick camera pan shows a grey wall decorated with multiple ornate antique-style mirrors. The video concludes with the man in the white shirt back at the red curtain background, waving the palette and smiling brightly.
